summary: B2Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K reporting a fatal workplace incident at the Masbate Gold Project in the Philippines on August 28, 2026. The employee was performing scheduled maintenance at the Water Treatment Plant when a pipe burst caused fatal injury. Mining and processing activities continue uninterrupted; the incident area is secured and related work stopped pending investigation. President and CEO Mike Cinnamond expressed condolences and stated the company's focus is supporting the family and investigating. This is an operational safety disclosure, not a special-situation corporate event. No deal terms, structural changes, or strategic actions are involved.
